name: ShellState (secondary flags)
comment: ShellState under HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced is a little-endian REG_BINARY value holding a DWORD size followed by the 32 byte SHELLSTATE structure. This definition describes the second bitfield at offset 0x20, which carries the seven BOOL members from fSepProcess through fShowStatusBar. Bits 7 to 15 are fSpareFlags and bits 16 to 31 are padding. Where the same setting also has its own value under Explorer\Advanced, Explorer uses the Advanced value, so change both when editing by hand.

fields.name: fSepProcess
fields.meaning: Launch folder windows in a separate process. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\SeparateProcess.

fields.name: fStartPanelOn
fields.meaning: Use the Windows XP style start menu.

fields.name: fAutoCheckSelect
fields.meaning: Use check boxes to select items. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\AutoCheckSelect.

fields.name: fIconsOnly
fields.meaning: Always show icons, never thumbnails. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\IconsOnly.

fields.name: fShowTypeOverlay
fields.meaning: Display the file type icon on thumbnails. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\ShowTypeOverlay.

fields.name: fShowStatusBar
fields.meaning: Show the status bar. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\ShowStatusBar.
